name: Guildmade Blade
description: A weapon built to the wielder’s own spec, not whatever the smith happened to have on the rack.

name: Guildmade Band
description: A ring cast and set by the guild’s own hand -- exactly the bonuses asked for, nothing left to chance.

name: Trail Rations
description: Smoked fish and dried herbs, packed for a hero who won’t be home for dinner.

name: Herbal Tonic
description: The Herb Garden’s own cure-all, brewed in-house rather than bought off a vendor’s shelf.

name: Minor Sigil
description: A working the Enchanter presses into a piece already carried, rather than anything built from scratch.
